beats.headline: Hats for the parade
beats.text: Donut's new Gurkha class has given her mercenaries and pets some pretty wild clothes. For the parade, the hats are the hit. Rosetta, riding Onikuma the bear, wears hers with pride and a glittering red gown. Bigs's is the size of a thimble on one eyestalk, Jamal's reshapes itself to fit a shark's head, and Samantha's brim stops her rolling properly. A mercenary's raises several melee skills by three levels; Donut's raises several skills by five, and there is no time to drain it into her tiara. Mongo gets kukri claw caps, and the mounts black-and-gold blankets worth twenty percent constitution and Steady Charge.
